newsitem.title: NORWAY: Denmark gears up for fifth oil licensing round.
newsitem.headline: Denmark gears up for fifth oil licensing round.

text.p: The Danish Energy Agency will submit its proposal for a fifth offshore licensing round to a parliamentary committee in May, Norway's state-owned Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Friday.

"We're due to submit proposals to the energy policy committee of the Folketing (parliament) by May 1," Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter quoted Peter Schroeder, manager for licence rounds at the Danish Energy Agency, as saying.
"This will detail relevant acreage for a fifth round and specify licence terms," Schroeder said.
Oil and gas companies will be given the opportunity to seek licences during the summer, with a deadline for applications next January.
Schroeder said acreage would likely be awarded in May 1998.
